item.title: In East St. Mary, winter is coming
item.description: On Wednesday, a year to the day after East St. Mary saw the biggest snowfall in a generation, locals heard about more winter weather to come.

item.title: On MLK Day, doctor has concerns about nation's health
item.description: BALDWIN — The medical man behind community health in St. Mary Parish is concerned with changes to health care emanating from the nation’s capital.

item.title: Krewe of Nike next up for Mardi Gras
item.description: Abigail Kathleen Photography Brayden Mayon and Ellis Cefalu have reigned as King and Queen Nike LIII since the 2025 ball. The new king and queen will be named Saturday. The younger generation takes over East St. Mary’s Mardi Gras celebration this week.

item.title: Former St. Mary teacher accused of trying to entice minor into sex
item.description: A federal grand jury in Lafayette returned an indictment on Dec. 17 charging Katherine Albarado with attempted enticement of a minor.

item.title: Dear Abby: Is husband's social media about lust or something more?
item.description: DEAR ABBY: I saw my husband’s Instagram account, and he’s following only women who show their bodies provocatively. Is that emotional cheating, or is it just lust?

item.title: Brrr-acing for winter's deepest freeze yet
item.description: St. Mary is in for an arctic blast – or as close as we usually come. Our neighbors closer to the Canadian border might call it “sweater weather.”

item.title: Jeremy Alford and David Jacobs: Louisiana Lottery sees revenue fall, considers online sales
item.description: Louisiana Lottery revenue has fallen to a three-year low, which could pose problems for state budget-writers if the trend continues.

item.title: St. Mary schools will be closed Monday
item.description: From the St. Mary Parish School Board: Meteorologists are forecasting record-breaking freezing temperatures in our region beginning Sunday, January 25, 2026.
